AI Overview
You can play Time Shooter 2 for free directly in your web browser on platforms like CrazyGames or Yandex Games. 
Overview
Developer: GoGoMan
Release Date: January 2022 (Updated through 2024)
Genre: First-person shooter (FPS) / Tactical puzzle game
Inspiration: Superhot 
Core Mechanics
Time Manipulation: Time moves only when your character moves. Standing still freezes the action and puts everything in slow motion so you can plan your next move.
One-Hit Death: You die from a single hit or bullet, which forces a level restart.
Weapons: Use pistols, assault rifles, shotguns, melee axes, heavy metal balls, and explosive pink gas cylinders. You can grab weapons straight from enemy hands or pick them up off tables. 
Controls
Move: WASD or arrow keys
Shoot / Pick Up: Left-click
Throw Weapons / Objects: Right-click or R
